title: WFP community kitchen kits boost Dinagat disaster response

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The World Food Programme (WFP) in the Philippines has provided community kitchen kits to the municipal governments of Dinagat Islands to strengthen disaster preparedness and improve emergency response operations across the province. Atty. Niel Edward Demerey, provincial information officer, said the ready-to-deploy cooking kits given to the municipalities included large-capacity rice cookers. Hannes Goegelle, WFP emergency officer, said the initiative, dubbed “Community Kitchen Kits: A Localized Kitchen Solution in Emergencies,” supports local resilience by providing practical resources that allow communities to respond quickly to immediate food needs during crises.
